import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: str = "notes"


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first readable file among names inside NOTES_DIR.

    NOTES_DIR is resolved relative to the current working directory. Names are
    tried in order and must be plain file names directly inside NOTES_DIR. A
    name is skipped if it is empty, is absolute, contains a path separator or
    "..", resolves outside NOTES_DIR (for example through a symlink), is
    missing, or cannot be decoded as UTF-8 text. Returns "" when no name yields
    a readable file, including when names is empty.
    """
    base = Path(NOTES_DIR).resolve()
    for name in names:
        if (
            not name
            or name in (".", "..")
            or os.path.isabs(name)
            or "/" in name
            or "\\" in name
        ):
            continue
        try:
            candidate = (base / name).resolve()
            if candidate.parent != base or not candidate.is_file():
                continue
            return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError):
            continue
    return ""


def test_returns_first_readable_in_order(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt", "b.txt"]) == "alpha"
    assert first_readable(["b.txt", "a.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_skips_missing_names(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["missing.txt", "b.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_empty_when_nothing_readable(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    assert first_readable(["x.txt", "", "."]) == ""
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_skips_undecodable_file(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "bin.dat").write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\xfd")
    (notes / "ok.txt").write_text("ok", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["bin.dat", "ok.txt"]) == "ok"


def test_rejects_parent_traversal(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["..\\secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_rejects_absolute_path(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable([str(secret.resolve())]) == ""


def test_rejects_nested_names(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    (notes / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (notes / "sub" / "c.txt").write_text("gamma", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub/c.txt"]) == ""


def test_rejects_symlink_escaping_notes(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    os.symlink(secret, notes / "link.txt")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""
